disposition: DiffATSM raw-audio diffusion time-scale-modification feasibility blocker. The official repository states that the full implementation will be released after publication and currently publishes only an abstract, citation, planned code structure and dependencies. No immutable revision, license text, source snapshot, PPG model, diffusion checkpoint, runtime, rights-cleared input or output is present or reproducible. The catalogued rate profile cannot be satisfied by a rendering system that has no runnable rate-only artefact.

evidence_snippets.phrase: It is an audio renderer candidate, not a standalone lightweight rate estimator.
full implementation will be released after publication

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the exact upstream repository at an immutable commit or release tag with the complete source snapshot, license text, notices and a source-to-artifact map. No download is permitted inside this package.
exact_blockers.statement: The recorded repository https://github.com/shjang-97/DiffATSM is described as publishing only an abstract, citation, planned code structure and dependencies. No immutable commit or release tag, source file, license text, COPYING/NOTICE or model card is staged, and no DiffATSM source tree exists at any probed path.

exact_blockers.required_action: Stage the complete asset set with exact file names, immutable revision, byte counts and matching SHA-256 values, plus an artifact-specific terms review. Do not reconstruct or infer a weight.
exact_blockers.statement: No PPG extractor, acoustic model, diffusion checkpoint, vocoder or inference configuration is named. There is no file name, revision, byte count, SHA-256, tensor layout or dependency lock, and no weight byte is present or downloaded.

exact_blockers.required_action: Provide a locked offline runtime with wheel names, versions, byte counts, SHA-256 values and install location, plus the exact device, dtype, step schedule, seed and padding recipe.
exact_blockers.statement: No diffusion runtime, interpreter lock, accelerator requirement, device, dtype, step schedule, seed or padding recipe is recorded. The probed interpreter exposes no torch, torchaudio, diffusers or DiffATSM module.

exact_blockers.required_action: Provide the license and notice text, reviewed code, weight, training-data and PPG-toolchain terms, and a digest-pinned rights-cleared caller input set with derived-output and redistribution decisions.
exact_blockers.statement: No upstream license, weight term, training-data statement, PPG corpus lineage, attribution bundle or rights-cleared caller input is staged or reviewed. The repository license field is unrecorded.

exact_blockers.required_action: After the source, asset, runtime and rights gates clear, run offline with deterministic settings and record per-item hashes, duration, pitch, transient, buffering, preservation and timing.
exact_blockers.statement: No DiffATSM render or rate result is reproduced. Without source, weights, runtime and inputs there is no identity/rate output, duration, pitch, transient, buffering, preservation or final-partial measurement.

exact_blockers.required_action: Measure mode and platform separately, record device timing and resources, run authorized listening or a labeled screen, then open a separate versioned OFF-by-default intake with clean-install proof and independent exact-head review.
exact_blockers.statement: No provider, descriptor, registry entry, default selection, mode or platform measurement, listening result, benchmark result or release claim exists. The package is task-local evidence only.

The research prose and repository URL are source-reported context only and are not promoted to measured evidence.
